title: Pool protocol v1 message: affinity_report (router -> coordinator)
description: Optional batch of cache-liveness hints: which conversations this router's KV cache is still warm for, and for how long. Used by the coordinator to prefer warm members for continuations (D-E2). At most 16 entries per report; routers MAY send these at any cadence.

router_id.description: Router_id of the sending router (as in handshake).

entries.description: Cache-liveness hints. At most 16 per report.

conv_key.description: Continuity key (64 hex) of the conversation.

idle_ms.description: Milliseconds since this conversation was last served on this router.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens currently cached for this conversation, or null if not measurable.
